'''Bottle of Jyrre''' is a {{Rare}} item. After reaching {{Green|300}} bonus {{stat|int}}, it evolves into a '''Refined Bottle of Jyrre'''.

== Obtaining ==
'''Bottle of Jyrre''' has a {{Chance|1.68%|1|59.64|gifts}} chance to drop from opening {{Item|Red Gift}}s.

== Usage ==
=== Aging Item ===
A '''Bottle of Jyrre''' gains {{stat|int|1}} every hour that the player is online with it in their inventory, taking 300 hours to reach the maximum buff of {{stat|int|300}}. {{Aging Items Process}}

Upon reaching {{Green|300}} bonus {{stat|int}}, the '''Bottle of Jyrre''' evolves into a '''Refined Bottle of Jyrre''' with the following message.
{{Dialogue|&d&lEVOLUTION! &dYour &cBottle of Jyrre &dhas evolved!}}
Drinking a '''Refined Bottle of Jyrre''' grants {{statname|int|300}} for {{Green|1 hour}}, as well as permanent {{stat|int|+1}}. This can be done 5 times.

Like the {{Item|Lost Bottle of Jyrre}}, the '''Bottle of Jyrre''' can be drank before it evolves.

Trying to drink a second '''Bottle of Jyrre''' will result in the following message:
{{Dialogue|&cYou already have an active Bottle of Jyrre!}}

== Trivia ==
*Jyrre is also an anagram of Jerry, which is the name's likely etymological origin.
*In a brewing stand, a '''Bottle of Jyrre''' acts much like a bottle of water, as it can be turned into an awkward potion using [[Nether Wart|nether warts]], which is not recommended.
*The NPC sell price does not increase until it becomes refined, unlike the {{Item|Lost Bottle of Jyrre}}.
*Drinking a '''Bottle of Jyrre''' will switch the player's hotbar slot one to the left, or if it's in the leftmost slot, one to the right, even if it fails due to one already being active.
